description_en: Queries the results of a digital watermarking (copyright watermark or tracing watermark) extraction job, including the job status and the successfully extracted watermark text
description_zh: 通过调用本接口查询数字水印（版权水印或溯源水印）的提取作业结果，包括数字水印提取作业的状态、成功提取出的水印文字等信息
name: GetDigitalWatermarkExtractResult

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the video to query. Only a single video ID is supported. You can obtain the video ID by using the following methods:
Log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Files > Audio/Video to view the video ID.
Call the [SearchMedia](~~SearchMedia~~) operation. The video ID (VideoId) is returned in the response
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的视频ID，仅支持传入单个视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
登录视频点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看视频ID。
通过[SearchMedia](~~SearchMedia~~)接口请求后会返回视频ID（VideoId）
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of watermark extraction. Valid values:

TraceMark: tracing watermark.
CopyrightMark: copyright watermark
parameters.help_zh:
水印提取类型。取值：

TraceMark：溯源水印
CopyrightMark：版权水印
parameters.name: extract_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the watermark extraction job.
The job ID is returned after you call the [SubmitDigitalWatermarkExtractJob](~~SubmitDigitalWatermarkExtractJob~~) operation.
If you specify this parameter, the result of the specified watermark extraction job is returned. If you do not specify this parameter, the results of all historical watermark extraction jobs for the video are returned
parameters.help_zh:
水印提取作业ID。
调用[SubmitDigitalWatermarkExtractJob](~~SubmitDigitalWatermarkExtractJob~~)接口后会返回。
传入该参数，则可查询指定水印提取作业ID的结果；不传，则默认返回该视频下所有历史水印提取作业的结果
parameters.name: job_id

AiExtractResultList.description_en: The details of the watermark extraction jobs

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the watermark extraction job was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 水印提取作业的创建时间

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned only when the watermark extraction job fails (the value of `Status` is `Failed`)
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 报错提示信息。当水印提取作业处理失败（即`Status`为`Failed`）时，才会返回本参数

JobId.description_en: The ID of the watermark extraction job

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the watermark extraction job was last updated
ModifyTime.description_zh: 水印提取作业的最后更新时间

Status.description_en:
The status of the watermark extraction job. Valid values:

Success: The job succeeded.
Failed: The job failed.
Processing: The job is being processed
Status.description_zh:
水印提取作业的状态。取值：

Success：成功
Failed：失败
Processing：处理中
